content:
Let \(T\) be the total slices each person eats.

The pepperoni-only friend eats \(T\) pepperoni slices.  
The other 3 people each eat equal pepperoni and cheese, so each eats \(T/2\) pepperoni slices.

Pepperoni eaten:
\[
T + 3\left(\frac{T}{2}\right)=15
\]
\[
\frac{5T}{2}=15 \implies T=6
\]

Cheese eaten by the 3 non-pepperoni-only people:
\[
3\left(\frac{6}{2}\right)=9
\]

Cheese left:
\[
16-9=7
\]

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
